experiment.name: finite adaptive interfaces over countably infinite interiors
experiment.question: When does a finite derivative admit a finite autonomous quotient, and when must exact repair grow without bound?

joint_conclusion.language_role: symbols serialize the current finite quotient; they neither contain nor exhaust the infinite fibre denoted by each symbol
joint_conclusion.retained_formulation: repair acts on a finite-index quotient of an infinite history or state space, not on a claim that the interior is finite
three_possible_behaviours: finite exact closure with infinite fibres
finite horizon sufficiency with continually revisable quotients

computed_invariance_check.status: finite computation supporting the symbolic dependency certificate; not the universal proof by itself

finite_reduction.reason: all registered task and repaired-interface laws are independent of n, so summing over any probability law on n cancels exactly

stable_infinite_fibre_case.mathematical_result: the repaired four-state interface is an exact autonomous quotient, while every one of its four fibres remains countably infinite
stable_infinite_fibre_case.name: stable finite quotient with infinite fibres

adaptive_interface_trace.interpretation: each verifier failure splits only the current infinite tail symbol by registering one more finite derivative coordinate; the new tail remains infinite and revisable

unbounded_countdown_case.name: finite predictive derivatives with no finite autonomous closure

nontermination_certificate.induction_rule: if 0..m-1 are singleton blocks, compare m with any r>m: their successors are m-1 and r-1>=m, which lie in distinct prefix and tail blocks; therefore m must split from the entire remaining tail
nontermination_certificate.mathematical_conclusion: by induction every n is forced to a singleton; the coarsest strongly lumpable refinement is the countably infinite identity

theorems.entropy_excess_formula: Delta H_C(pi_m)=(1-p)^m H(Geometric(p)), finite even though Delta K_C(pi_m) is countably infinite
theorems.finite_horizon_sufficiency: q_H(n)=0^n 1^(H-n) for n<H and 0^H for n>=H, so q_H factors exactly through pi_H and all H+1 blocks are distinct
theorems.no_finite_dynamic_closure: at threshold m, compare m with any r>m: their successors lie in the singleton m-1 and the remaining tail; hence m is forced to a singleton. Induction forces every n to split, so the identity is the coarsest strongly lumpable refinement
theorems.small_residual_warning: L_lump(pi_m) tends to zero as m tends to infinity, but no finite m is dynamically closed; arbitrarily small residual does not imply finite exact repair

verification.boundary: the universal countdown nontermination result is proved by induction in the report; finite computation checks instances and formulas but is not presented as the proof
